1.source_text: Jehoshaphat, however, remembered that, under the government of God, good men always regarded it as a duty and a privilege, before embarking in any movement involving important consequences, to seek, through the Prophet of God, new revelation for their direction. He therefore said to Ahab, “ Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the Lord to-day.”
